name: orion-windows Desktop CI
originalTriggers: completion of pipeline 'orion-lib Pack and Publish' (Orion Commerce) on main: becomes workflow_run, and the corelib run name becomes the corelibBuild input

taskMap.github: run (pwsh): msbuild for every .sln with the same /p: arguments
run (pwsh): dotnet vstest on the *Tests.dll assemblies outside obj
taskMap.note: selection by assembly is kept; the VSTest task's reporting and settings are not

taskMap.github: run steps with shell: pwsh (sign.ps1 and the installer collection)

acceptedWarnings.why: The source gives these jobs no environment and keeps the credentials at repository level (Azure variable groups are not environment-scoped). Scoping them to a GitHub environment is a hardening choice for the reviewer; it would add approvals and deployment records the source does not have.

notes: The signing certificate identified by the thumbprint must be installed on the runner; this workflow cannot provide it.
The container image and the redis service are pinned by digest (see ACTION_PINS.md) where the source used tags, because the gates reject unpinned images; they will not follow tag updates.

The 'toolbox' container resource (private registry, endpoint orion-acr) is declared by the source but used by no job: it is not converted. The redis port mapping is dropped: inside a container job the service is reached by name.
The workflow_run chaining from orion-lib is not part of the file: original triggers are enabled by a separate approval.
